text:
alex ng: deploy-bot just alerted: canary health checks failing in us-west & eu-west :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy 2026-03-15T09:11Z FAILED - 18/40 pods CrashLoopBackOff - manifest signature mismatch

maria r: oncall — I'm seeing a sharp error spike at 09:11 UTC. Traces show runtime signature verification failing on image pull.

samir: ack. grabbing logs. leo, paste the pod stderr

leo: pod log snippet:
```
E0315 09:11:23.123 signature_verifier.go:78] manifest_verification_failed: wrong_key: expected "rdw-prod-v1" got "rdw-rotate-03"
image: redwood/inference:2026.03.15-canary
manifest_digest: sha256:abcd1234...
```

maya: that shouldn't happen — CI signs with rdw-prod-v1. checking the signing-service runs now.

oncall-bot: paging samir for P1 incident: canary signature mismatch — respond in channel

samir: declaring incident P1. quick actions:
- pause canary rollout
- flip kill-switch to route to stable image
- investigate CI signing job for key used

alex ng: pausing: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/inference-canary -n prod` — pause confirmed

leo: flipping feature flag: `ffctl set inference.use_signed_manifest false --env=prod` — confirmed. traffic shifted away from canary.

maria r: immediate effect: error rate back down within 2 minutes; only ~1.8% of traffic affected.

maya: CI job id: `ci-sign-2206-2026-03-15-0910`. signer log shows `signed_by=rdw-rotate-03`. There was a key rotation job at 08:58.

anita: ops-kms here. we ran a staged rotation at 08:58 but an alias promotion script had a faulty regex. it matched `rdw-.*-v1` and promoted the rotate key into the prod alias. fixing now.

samir: timeline draft:
- 08:58 rotation job rot-2026-03-15-0858 ran
- 09:10 CI sign job used current alias and produced signature with rdw-rotate-03
- 09:11 canary pods failed signature check
- 09:13 oncall-bot paged
- 09:15 rollout paused & flag flipped
- 09:22 traffic normalized

anita: alias reverted at 09:34. verified alias -> rdw-prod-v1. ran verification signing test: OK.

maria r: do we rebuild canary images? We can't reuse images signed by rotate key for prod canary.

samir: do a clean rebuild & sign with rdw-prod-v1. add smoke test. DO NOT resume until we validate signature chain.

leo: triggered rebuild: `ci-rebuild-2207-2026-03-15-0938` will produce `redwood/inference:2026.03.15-canary-2`

deploy-bot: [INFO] rebuild queued

maria r: customer impact note: minor; recommend post-incident note + outreach AS-NEEDED. tagging legal & cs to review.

samir: follow-ups assigned:
- ops-kms: fix alias regex + add unit test (owner: anita)
- ci: add alias sanity check pre-sign (owner: maya)
- release: add manifest-signature gate before unpause (owner: leo)
- oncall: update runbook for feature-flag kill-switch & verification (owner: samir)

anita: will add a safeguard: block alias promotions that affect prod without explicit confirmation. rolling change now.

maria r: timeline & notes will be added to incident doc. moving to postmortem workflow.

samir: incident declared resolved at 09:52 UTC. reopening if anything else pops up.
